description: Antennes relais et dossiers d'information mairie is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Ce jeu de données contient les antennes relais de téléphonie mobile des 4 opérateurs existants (Orange, SFR, Bouygues Télécom et Free Mobile) présentes sur le territoire des communes signataires de la charte relative à l’implantation des antennes relais de téléphonie mobile sur le territoire de l’Eurométropole. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are antenne, relais, Strasbourg. The portal shows 1,101 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-12-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
